# git: alias: deinit submodule

Add an alias that removes a submodule completely. **Motivation:** "I actively use it and want to reduce manual job." The algorithm:

```bash
$ git submodule deinit -f a/module
$ rm -rf .git/modules/a/module
$ git rm -f a/module
# it should remove module from .gitmodules too, but if not
$ git config -f .gitmodules --remove-section submodule.a/module
```

Checklist of places that must end up clean: `.git/config`, `.git/modules/`, `.gitmodules`.
